description: Delete one durable memory document identified by (scope, kind) for the authenticated user. Provide project_id for project-local memory, or null/omit for global. Identity comes from Core via the session bearer, not from input.

kind.description: Memory kind to delete, e.g. study_preference or project_learning_context.

project_id.description: Project UUID for project-local memory; null or omitted deletes global (user-level) memory.

name: delete-memory

deleted.description: Always true when the delete succeeds.

projectId.description: Owning project UUID, or null for global memory.

userId.description: Owner of the deleted memory document.

title: Delete Studocu Agent Memory
